entities.summary: Greg P. Russell is an American re-recording mixer. He is a 16-time Academy Award nominated post-production sound mixer who has worked in the film industry for more than 40 years, contributing to over 235 feature films. He had been the individual with the most Oscar nominations without a single win, with 16 nominations, before songwriter Diane Warren received her 17th nomination in 2026. He received Oscar nominations for his work on Black Rain, The Rock, Con Air, Armageddon, The Mask of Zorro, The Patriot, Pearl Harbor, Spider-Man, Spider- Man 2, Memoirs of a Geisha, Apocalypto, Transformers 1, 2 & 3, Salt and Skyfall.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a 16-time Academy Award nominated post-production sound mixer with over 40 years of experience, Greg P. Russell has contributed to numerous iconic films, including Black Rain and Spider-Man. His work has had a significant impact on the film industry, shaping the soundtracks that accompany some of the most beloved movies in history.
